晚上9点，KTV散场。

“路上小心。”

魏沐弯腰朝着出租车后排挥了挥手。

车内，刘施施扒着窗户，依依不舍的望着他，眼里全是故事。

“魏沐哥哥再见。”

郭小婷同样不舍。

今天发生的事，对于一个15岁的孩子冲击力太大。

魏沐气质出众，笑容温暖，唱歌又那么好听。

只听了一次，郭小婷就变成了他的小迷妹。

年少时不能遇见太惊艳的人，否则余生不过尔尔。

她现在就是这种状态。

随着出租车越开越远，胡哥迈步来到魏沐身边。

“你和施施好，我没有意见，甚至会替你们保守秘密，但是老板那边......”

他的意思很明白，K姐肯定不同意。

魏沐茫然地看着对方。

叽里咕噜说什么呢？老蔡不同意关我屁事。

再说了，老蔡能干什么。

唐人这家公司有毒。

一姐有一个算一个，全是恋爱脑。

老蔡不同意又怎样，还不是被拐跑？

从关咏荷到刘施施，拦得住嘛。

这个时候，看穿一切的袁红来到魏沐右边站定，轻轻拍了拍他的肩膀说道：“老魏，虽然哥哥比你年长几岁，但在泡妞方面，你才是前辈，我服了。”

你又是什么情况。

咋唱了首歌，一个两个都神神叨叨的....

不过今天这场聚会，无疑拉近了他们之间的关系。

“行啦，我们俩先撤，有空多联系。”

........

等从KTV回到上戏，时间已经到了晚上10点。

从楼下看过去，大四宿舍基本熄灯。

临近毕业，表演系的学生跑剧组，摄影系和导演系的学生到处接活。

离开了学校这个温床，大家都在努力找机会。

来到602宿舍门口，里面还亮着微光，魏沐好奇走进，然后就看到三个大男人在玩斗地主。

陈贺脸上贴满了纸条，一看就输得很惨。

见到他回来，陈贺赶忙把牌扔下去，起身迎接。

“老魏，又和哪个美眉约会，这么晚才回来？”

“靠，陈贺，还没结束，你就把牌扔了？”

“耍赖是吧！！”

杜姜郑凯骂骂咧咧的站起来。

看着过来迎接的三人，魏沐知道，不知不觉中，他已经成为了这个宿舍的核心人物。

在此之前，核心人物是陈贺。

“你们俩面试情况怎么样？”

“没有选上。”

At 9pm, the KTV ends.

"Be careful on the road."

Wei Mu bent down and waved towards the back of the taxi.

In the car, Liu Shishi opened the window and looked at him reluctantly, his eyes full of stories.

"Goodbye, brother Wei Mu."

Guo Xiaoting was also reluctant to give up.

What happened today had a huge impact on a 15-year-old child.

Wei Mu has an outstanding temperament, a warm smile, and sings so beautifully.

After listening to it only once, Guo Xiaoting became his little crush.

You can't meet someone who is too amazing when you are young, otherwise the rest of your life will be mediocre.

This is her current state.

As the taxi drove farther and farther, Brother Hu stepped towards Wei Mu.

"I have no objection to you and Shi Shi getting along well, and I will even keep your secrets, but the boss..."

His meaning was very clear, and Sister K would definitely disagree.

Wei Mu looked at each other blankly.

What did Jili Gulu say?It's none of my business if Lao Cai disagrees.

Besides, what can Lao Cai do?

This company in Tang Dynasty is poisonous.

One sister after another, she is all about love.

So what if Lao Cai doesn't agree? Are you kidnapped?

From Guan Yonghe to Liu Shishi, can we stop him?

At this time, Yuan Hong, who had seen through everything, came to stand on the right side of Wei Mu, patted his shoulder gently and said, "Old Wei, although my brother is a few years older than you, you are the senior when it comes to picking up girls, and I accept it."

What's your situation?

I sang a song, and both of them were chattering away...

But today's gathering has undoubtedly brought them closer.

"Okay, let's evacuate first and keep in touch when we have time."

........

By the time we returned to the theater from KTV, it was already 10pm.

Looking from downstairs, the lights in the senior dormitory are basically turned off.

As graduation approaches, students from the acting department work on the set, and students from the photography department and directing department take on jobs everywhere.

After leaving the hotbed of school, everyone is trying to find opportunities.

Arriving at the door of dormitory 602, there was still a faint light inside. Wei Mu walked in curiously, and then saw three grown men playing Landlords.

Chen He's face was covered with notes, and he lost miserably at first glance.

Seeing him coming back, Chen He quickly threw down the cards and stood up to greet him.

"Old Wei, which girl are you dating and come back so late?"

"Damn, Chen He, you threw away the cards before it's over?"

"It's a shame, right?"

Du Jiang and Zheng Kai stood up cursing.

Looking at the three people who came to greet them, Wei Mu knew that unknowingly, he had become the core figure in this dormitory.

Before that, the core character was Chen He.

"How was your interview going?"

"Not selected."
